patch_resolves_note: The staged `patch.diff` did not apply to the prepared vulnerable checkout `93f5acbb...`, so fixed-side validation used the authoritative `n132/arvo:42534645-fix` image instrumented with the same three source events. On the stock PoC that fixed original stays clean and guards the downstream GUID parse after the root event; on the closest source-grounded witness `stream_type_guid_tail_append4`, the fixed original genuinely executes the same GUID parse with a full 16-byte stream-type GUID and remains clean.
verification_limitations: Fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative `-fix` image because `switch-fixed --patch patch.diff` failed on the staged checkout at `93f5acbbff7dacc66cfa02a56957c5746a7c107c`.

The reused vulnerable workspace's incremental target rebuild did not detect Exiv2's build directory layout, so Stage 04 fell back to `/bin/arvo compile`; that fallback needed a stale `build/corpus` directory removed before it returned success.

root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `streamProperties()` may parse `GUIDTag(streamTypedBuf.data())`, the remaining payload bytes must cover the 16-byte stream-type GUID read so the buffer handed to GUID parsing is a complete GUID.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original reaches the protected GUID parse even though only 12 bytes remain for a 16-byte `io_->read(GUID)` request. The authoritative fixed original is guarded on the stock PoC, and the closest tail-append witness `stream_type_guid_tail_append4` genuinely executes the same protected parse with `remaining_payload_bytes=16` and `guid_bytes=16`.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable original trace records `stream_type_root_guard.remaining_payload_bytes=12` and `guid_bytes=16` while `stream_type_guid_parse` still executes, so the required predicate is violated at the protected event. The fixed original records the same `12 < 16` root state but no downstream parse event, making the original case guarded; appending 4 bytes to the file tail yields the genuine fixed witness with `16 >= 16` and all three events executed cleanly.

nodes.description: At the `GUIDTag(streamTypedBuf.data())` parse call that leads directly into the ASan-reported constructor read, the vulnerable original presents only 12 bytes of `streamTypedBuf` to a 16-byte GUID parse.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `stream_type_guid_parse.guid_bytes=16` and `stream_type_guid_parse.stream_type_bytes=12` immediately before the GUID parse call.

nodes.description: The vulnerable `io_->read(GUID)` call materializes a truncated `DataBuf` because the partial-read API returns only the bytes still available at the end of the object payload instead of enforcing a full 16-byte GUID read.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `stream_type_short_read.stream_type_bytes=12` and `guid_bytes=16` immediately after the `io_->read(GUID)` call.

edges.relation: The same `streamTypedBuf` storage returned by the short read is passed unchanged into `GUIDTag(streamTypedBuf.data())`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original assertion trace records `stream_type_short_read.stream_type_ptr == stream_type_guid_parse.guid_argument_ptr`.

edges.relation: On the witnessed short-read path, the bytes remaining before `io_->read(GUID)` become the logical size of the returned `streamTypedBuf`.
edges.evidence: The vulnerable original trace records `stream_type_root_guard.remaining_payload_bytes == stream_type_short_read.stream_type_bytes == 12`, and the fixed witness preserves the same relation at `16 == 16` when the guarded parse genuinely executes.
